kandoInfo.heading: Kando Martial Arts Knox
description: Kando Martial Arts was established in 1997 by Chief Instructor Shihan Paul Veldman, a highly respected martial arts instructor with decades of experience.
Shihan Paul is a 6th Degree Black Belt in Karate and began training at age 13, later specialising in traditional Shukokai Karate.
Sensei Andy started karate at a young age and developed confidence, resilience, and leadership through years of dedicated training.
With over a decade of teaching experience, Sensei Andy now leads Kando Martial Arts Knox, delivering high-quality karate instruction to families from across the Knox area.
Kando Martial Arts Knox proudly supports students travelling from Knoxfield with structured, traditional karate training.

getToKando.heading: Getting to Kando Martial Arts Knox from Knoxfield
description: Knoxfield families interested in martial arts often find Kando Martial Arts Knox to be an excellent fit, particularly those who value structured learning and character development alongside physical training. Our Boronia location offers Knoxfield residents access to experienced instructors and a curriculum that grows with students from beginner to advanced levels.

The drive from Knoxfield to our Boronia dojo usually takes around 10 to 15 minutes. Take Stud Road heading north toward Boronia, then turn onto Burwood Highway. From Burwood Highway, turn into Lewis Road, followed by a turn into Wadhurst Drive. Our facility is located at Unit 2/5 Wadhurst Drive, Boronia.

Knoxfield students appreciate the balance between accessibility and quality that our location provides. The manageable distance means families can commit to regular training while still accessing professional instruction. Many Knoxfield members become regular attendees, building strong connections within our martial arts community.
